purpose: Every page a reader opens reads right, hardest books first, paid for with subscription capacity that would otherwise go unused. Claude is the final arbiter; Gemini review is a second opinion.

number.name: served_serious_error_rate_by_eye
number.frame: one random served page per book, all lanes, frame-weighted

measure_of_purpose: verified pages per week weighted by difficulty (pareto accuracy of the page's lane, src/data/ocr-pareto.json) and readership (books.human_read_count, PR #6809); first unweighted count about 10,000 pages, 2026-10-11 to 10-16
outside_check: Containment debt beside the rate: 3,004 live books under a text-trust hold on 2026-10-16 (about 1,740 on 10-11). Cross-family: Gemini second reader (#6338, Phase 2 not run); Clef image-text screen (#5803). Single-reader random draw 2026-10-16: 31.0% of 551 non-English books serious (#6420).
